purpose: Public health research on asthma treatment.
question: Among adults with asthma, what percentage are on active salmeterol/fluticasone, by sex?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
Salmeterol/fluticasone = ATC code starting with R03AK.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per sex: adults with asthma, % with an active salmeterol/fluticasone.
